body: a1ededd adds original-over-ours spectrograms to playbook phase 5, with images outside the repo and deleted with the recordings. dfead0f is on origin. Two open games: the older game keeps the build agents, one per mechanic group; the new game does phases 0-3 only (sources, rows, MAME map, first fixtures). Build agents move over only for groups the older game has finished or that are blocked on a measurement. Name the fixture landing order in prompts, since both games share the manifest (per-game manifests, #23, fix most of this). Lesson: resolve a rebased commit's finding with the hash that already fixed it.
summary: Spectrograms agreed (a1ededd, in review); two open games: build agents stay on the older game, the new one runs research phases 0-3 only
